Please Try Again. Powered by Reelgood Jaw-dropping. Explosive. Unspeakably good. Those are just a few of the words Paradise stars used to tease the highly-anticipated Season 2 finale for DECIDER. “I feel like with every question answered, five more come up. So it leaves you satisfied, but wanting more,” Julianne Nicholson teased. “No one in America is ready. Get your tissues out. You’re going to have a field day, because you’re going to cry,” Ryan Michelle Bathé said. On the heels of a jaw-dropping, mind-blowing Episode 7, we’ve never been more excited to see what the hit Hulu series has in store. Will the major Alex mystery finally be revealed? Will Xavier (Sterling K. Brown) find Link (Thomas Doherty) and catch him up about Annie (Shailene Woodley) and the baby? Will Teri (Enuka Okuma) reunite with her kids? Is Jane (Nicole Brydon Bloom) really dead? What other plans does Sinatra (Julianne Nicholson) have up her sleeve? Will the bunker blow because of conflicting security commands? And is Link really Sinatra’s son, Dylan?! Hulu’s official synopsis for Paradise Season 2, Episode 8, “Exodus” is as follows: “Worlds collide. Time is of the essence for Xavier. Link and his team spring into action. Sinatra puts it all on the line.” Once you’ve checked out all of our juicy Season 2 finale teases from Nicholson, Doherty, Shahi, and Bathé, read on to learn how to watch Paradise‘s Season 2 finale ASAP. When does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 come out on Hulu? What time does Paradise come out? How many episodes are in Paradise Season 2? And will there be a Paradise Season 3? Here’s everything to know about the Paradise Season 2 finale, including premiere date, time, how to watch, and more. When Does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Come Out? Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Premiere Date: Curious when Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 comes out? You can stream Paradise Season 2 Episode 8 starting Monday, March 30. But depending on which timezone you’re in you may be able to watch sooner… What Time Does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Come Out? New episodes of Paradise Season 2 premiere on Hulu Mondays at 12:00 a.m. ET, which means they’ll be available to stream on Sundays at 9:00 p.m. PT. So Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 will be streaming on Monday, March 30 at 12:00 a.m. ET / Sunday, March 29 at 9:00 p.m. PT. Photo: Disney/Ser Baffo How Many Episodes Are In Paradise Season 2? When Is The Paradise Season 2 Finale? Like Season 2 before it, Paradise Season 2 consists of eight episodes, which means Season 2, Episode 8 is the finale. Paradise Season 2 Episode Guide: When Do New Episodes Of Paradise Season 2 Come Out? After Paradise Season 2’s three episode premiere on Monday, February 23, new episodes of Paradise will drop weekly on Mondays — or Sundays if you’re on the west coast! Looking for a Paradise Season 2 episode guide with corresponding dates? We’ve got you covered: Season 2, Episode 1: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 2: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 3: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 4: Monday, March 2 Season 2, Episode 5: Monday, March 9 Season 2, Episode 6: Monday, March 16 Season 2, Episode 7: Monday, March 23 Season 2, Episode 8: Monday, March 30 Will There Be A Paradise Season 3? You bet! On March 17, ahead of Season 2’s final two episodes, Hulu renewed Paradise for Season 3. Since the start, creator Dan Fogelman was open about having a three-season arc in mind. He’s also said he plans to end the series after its third season. So we’ll have to wait and see if that’s still the course he plans to take. How To Watch Paradise: Hulu Streaming Info Since Paradise is a Hulu original series, you’ll have to be a subscriber to watch. (You can also watch through Hulu on Disney+ if you’re a bundle subscriber.) Season 1 aired on broadcast following its finale, so it’s likely that will be the case with Season 2. But until then, here’s how to watch: If you’re new to Hulu, you can get started with a 30-day free trial on the streamer’s basic (with ads) plan. After the trial period, you’ll pay $10.99/month. If you want to upgrade to Hulu ad-free, it costs $18.99/month. If you want to stream even more and save a few bucks a month while you’re at it, we recommend subscribing to one of the Disney+ Bundles, all of which include Hulu. These bundles start at $12.99/month for ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu and goes up to $32.99/month for Disney+, Hulu, and Max, all ad-free. Stay tuned for more Paradise Season 2 coverage from Decider.
